translations_only.description: Translations form abelian subgroup; cannot produce c≠0 or scaling

dilations_only.description: Dilations form abelian subgroup; cannot produce b≠0 or c≠0

rotations_only.description: Rotations form abelian subgroup SO(2); cannot produce |a|≠1, b≠0, c≠0

T_and_D.description: T+D generate affine group az+b; cannot produce c≠0 (no inversion)

T_and_R.description: T+R generate rigid motions (Euclidean group); cannot produce scaling or c≠0

D_and_R.description: D+R generate diagonal matrices; cannot produce b≠0 or c≠0

inversion_independence.explanation: T, D, R generate only affine maps (c=0). Inversion introduces c!=0, required for full Mobius group.

generators.translation: T_b: z -> z+b, matrix [[1,b],[0,1]], arithmetic: addition
generators.dilation: D_lambda: z -> lambda*z, matrix [[lambda,0],[0,1]], arithmetic: multiplication
generators.rotation: R_theta: z -> e^{i*theta}*z, matrix [[e^{itheta},0],[0,1]], arithmetic: exponentiation (Euler)

group_structure.TDR_generate: Affine group (az+b), proper subgroup of Mobius
group_structure.minimal_generators: T, D (or R), and I suffice; T+D+R is redundant for affine but all 4 types needed for full group

algebraic_independence.conclusion: D and R commute (both diagonal/multiplicative), but T is algebraically independent from D,R. I is independent from all three.
